response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown')), shares AS (SELECT hand, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT hand, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT hand, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY tally DESC, hand;
